tweet.text:
I've been thinking so hard trying to wrap my mind around stateless and sleeping so little it's giving me migraines. When i'm not near my pc i'm dictating into apps I'm having it build to my ends.

The best part? I'm not discovering anything.

It was there, Wildest shit fam.
